functions.name: LoadPreInitModules
functions.docs: Load the preinit modules required by this platform, typically they are the renderer modules

functions.name: LoadStartupModules
functions.docs: Load the platform-specific startup modules

functions.name: CreateConsoleOutputDevice
functions.docs: Creates a console output device for this platform. Should only be called once.

functions.name: GetErrorOutputDevice
functions.docs: Gets a pointer to the platform error output device singleton.

functions.name: GetFeedbackContext
functions.docs: Gets a pointer to the default platform feedback context implementation.

functions.name: CreatePlatformInputDeviceManager
functions.docs: Gets a pointer to the default platform input device manager.

functions.name: CreateApplication
functions.docs: Creates an application instance.

functions.name: RequestMinimize
functions.docs: Request application to minimize (goto background). *

functions.name: IsThisApplicationForeground
functions.docs: Returns true if the specified application has a visible window, and that window is active/has focus/is selected

functions.name: RequiresVirtualKeyboard
functions.docs: Returns whether the platform wants to use a touch screen for a virtual keyboard.

functions.name: PumpMessages
functions.docs:
Pumps Windows messages.
@param bFromMainLoop if true, this is from the main loop, otherwise we are spinning waiting for the render thread

functions.name: PreventScreenSaver
functions.docs:
Prevents screen-saver from kicking in by moving the mouse by 0 pixels. This works even
in the presence of a group policy for password protected screen saver.

functions.name: IsScreensaverEnabled
functions.docs:
Returns state of screensaver (if platform supports it)
@return	true if screensaver enabled (returns false if platform does not support it)

SetHighDPIMode
functions.docs: Allows the OS to enable high DPI mode

functions.name: GetDPIScaleFactorAtPoint
functions.docs:
Returns monitor's DPI scale factor at given screen coordinates (expressed in pixels)
@return Monitor's DPI scale factor at given point

functions.name: IsHighDPIAwarenessEnabled
functions.docs: @return true if the application is high dpi aware

functions.name: AnchorWindowWindowPositionTopLeft
functions.docs:
UE expects mouse coordinates in screen space. Some platforms provides in client space.
Return true to anchor the window at the top/left corner to make sure client space coordinates and screen space coordinates match up.

functions.name: SetGamepadsAllowed
functions.docs: Set whether gamepads are allowed at the platform level.

functions.name: SetGamepadsBlockDeviceFeedback
functions.docs: Set whether gamepads are allowed at the platform level.

functions.name: ResetGamepadAssignments
functions.docs: Resets the gamepad to player controller id assignments

functions.name: ResetGamepadAssignmentToController
functions.docs: Resets the gamepad assignment to player controller id

functions.name: IsControllerAssignedToGamepad
functions.docs: Returns true if controller id assigned to a gamepad

functions.name: GetGamepadControllerName
functions.docs: Returns name of gamepad if controller id assigned to a gamepad

functions.name: GetGamepadButtonGlyph
functions.docs: Returns a texture of the glyph representing the specified button on the specified controller, or nullptr if not supported.

functions.name: EnableMotionData
functions.docs:
Whether to enable controller motion data polling (by default motion data is enabled)
Some platforms may want to disable it to reduce battery drain

functions.name: IsMotionDataEnabled
functions.docs: Whether controller motion data polling is enabled (by default motion data is enabled)

functions.name: ClipboardCopy
functions.docs: Copies text to the operating system clipboard.

functions.name: ClipboardPaste
functions.docs: Pastes in text from the operating system clipboard.

functions.name: GetPhysicalScreenDensity
functions.docs: Gets the physical size of the screen if possible.  Some platforms lie, some platforms don't know.

functions.name: ComputePhysicalScreenDensity
functions.docs: Gets the physical size of the screen if possible.  Some platforms lie, some platforms don't know.
